Step 3–4 — Business Operations verifies the mandatory items across departments. The Go Live button is only enabled for Business Operations once every mandatory Pre-Live item is complete. SLA: checklist completed no later than H-1 before launch.

Step 5–7 — The Campaign Date drives the reconciliation reminders (H+7, H+1 month) and escalation if not reconciled (H+2 months → campaign stop → LinkIT report stop → final warning).
